synth.notes:
Arrows move player 3px on an invisible floor; if its next rect overlaps a block, the block is kicked (player stays) and slides 3/step as a growing chain.
Chain stops when any member would leave the floor, overlap the player, or overlap a non-fitting socket interior (bbox minus 1px border).
Click on a block: player takes its rect, block consumed; blocks re-ranked token_i by (y,x). Stateless.
Missed mechanic (step 78): floor has an upper corridor x18-29,y30-35 west of the room, so token_0 stops at x=18 (wall-rect programs let it slide to 0/3); step 87 shows corridor narrows to rows 42-47 for x<15.
Unconfirmed: exact floor beyond observed stops, fitting-block socket entry, actions 5/7 (no-op).
